AI-PM-Wiki/AIPM.body:
# Welcome to **AI-PM**!

**AI-PM** (AI Product Manager) is an integrated knowledge site for AI product management. It offers knowledge and practice on AI product methodology, models and tools, prompt engineering, agents and workflows, and evaluation and iteration, to help you learn AI product design faster and more deeply.

Site address: [https://aipm.ac](https://aipm.ac)

* * *

## Contents

- Product methodology: requirements analysis, user research, product design, project management
- AI fundamentals: LLM capability boundaries, prompt engineering, RAG, agents and workflows
- Tools and platforms: mainstream AI products and platforms, evaluation and feedback systems
- Case studies: AI product teardowns and retrospectives

* * *

## Deployment

This project is built with [MkDocs](https://github.com/mkdocs/mkdocs). (**Python3 and uv must be installed**)

```bash
# Install uv (if not already installed)
pip install uv

# Install dependencies
uv sync --index-url https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple/

# Install the custom theme (on Windows, run this under Git Bash)
# Installing the theme downloads resources over the network; the download links can be controlled via the following config items
# .gitmodules:
# - url
./scripts/pre-build/install-theme.sh

# Two options (choose one):
# 1. Run a local server; visit http://127.0.0.1:8000 to view the site
uv run mkdocs serve -v

# 2. Generate static pages in the site folder
uv run mkdocs build -v

# Show the mkdocs command-line help (explains the meaning of commands and options)
uv run mkdocs --help
```

* * *

## How to Contribute to AI-PM

We warmly welcome you to write content for **AI-PM** and share what you have learned with everyone. For how to participate, writing guidelines, and the submission process, see [How to Contribute](https://github.com/AI-PM-Wiki/AIPM/blob/HEAD/docs/intro/htc.md).

All changes must pass the following checks (run them all locally before submitting):

- `git diff --check`: whitespace error check
- `uv run mkdocs build -q`: site build
- `python3 scripts/check-characters.py`: character standards check
- `uv run python scripts/check-doc-links.py`: in-site Markdown/HTML links and heading anchors

# Folio · 折纸面板

Folio 是一款用于管理 Linux 服务器的 Web 面板。它把主机状态、网站与软件、文件与终端、计划任务、账户安全和操作审计放在同一个界面中；支持 MCP 的客户端也可以在授权后调用面板提供的能力。

服务端使用 Go，管理界面以静态资源嵌入发行包。运行 Folio 不需要在服务器上常驻 Node.js、Python 或 AI 模型进程。可选的主机执行器默认关闭，只有配置 root 私有策略后才会启用。

## 功能

- 查看主机概览、资源指标、服务状态和共享便签。
- 管理网站、证书和软件目录中的服务。
- 浏览文件，使用受控终端和计划任务。
- 查看数据库与缓存连接、任务进度和操作记录。
- 管理账户安全、会话、MCP 客户端授权和界面主题。

网站与数据库备份不再设置固定总大小上限，仍使用流式处理和完整性校验。计划任务支持数据库备份、最终任务结果、失败通知、重叠执行和错过执行策略。

Cheese-nya/uku-furigana.description: Automatically annotates kanji in text with kana, translates it, and outputs it as SRT, TXT, or DOCX
Cheese-nya/uku-furigana.body:
# Furigana Dubbing Studio

An offline furigana (ルビ) annotation and layout tool for Japanese learners. It addresses mispronunciation of polyphonic characters, counter sound changes, jukujikun (熟字訓) splitting, and Word layout misalignment.

---

## Problems Solved

Common kana annotation tools simply look up dictionaries, which often produces the following errors:

| Scenario | Common error | How this tool handles it |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Polyphonic characters** | `辛い` readings confused (spicy vs. painful) | Distinguishes `からい` from `つらい` automatically using surrounding particles; `何` (なに/なん) and `風` (かぜ/ふう) are handled the same way |
| **Counter sound changes** | `一発` and `一本` read as いちはつ and いちほん | Built-in numeral-counter sound change rules correctly output `いっぱつ`, `いっぽん`, `三分(さんぷん)`, and other sokuon and handakuon forms |
| **Jukujikun** | `二人` split into `二(に)人(にん)` | Recognizes the whole compound and annotates it as `二人(ふたり)` or `大人(おとな)`; verb okurigana are aligned precisely |
| **Print layout** | After export to Word, kana drop off or turn into parentheses | Outputs the standard Word `<w:ruby>` structure, with kana centered above the kanji; font size and line spacing are adjustable |

100% local and works offline. It uploads no text.

---

## Interface Preview

### Main Workspace
Enter the source text on the left; the annotated layout is shown live on the right. Supports switching between hiragana, katakana, and romaji, and paginates long text.

### Click-to-Proofread and Whole-Compound Annotation
Clicking a kanji opens a popup with candidate readings and the sentence it appears in. You can expand the selection to the right to annotate a compound (for example, extending「二」to「二人」and annotating it「ふたり」). Confirmed readings are automatically learned for the same context within the current script.

### Proper Noun Dictionary
Manage character names, place names, and other special readings. Longer words are matched first. Supports JSON import and export.

### Batch Processing
Supports batch import of `.txt`, `.srt`, and `.docx` files. Titles are extracted automatically from file names, and files are annotated in parallel and exported.

---

## Feature List

- **Contextual morphological engine**: Built on local Kuromoji, with polyphone disambiguation rules and a counter sound change table.
- **Three annotation views**: hiragana (for beginners), katakana (advanced), and romaji (reading aid).
- **Web Worker asynchronous processing**: Tokenization runs in the background, so large text input does not freeze the UI. Real-time progress display and debounced interruption.
- **Interactive proofreading**:
  - Click a kanji to edit it directly, with a side-by-side view of the surrounding sentence.
  - Expand to the right to annotate a whole compound.
  - Context memory: words in the same context within one document automatically reuse proofreading results.
  - Priority: manual proofreading > annotations in the source > context memory > proper noun dictionary > automatic tokenization.
- **Multi-format import and export**:
  - **Word (`.docx`)**: Native `<w:ruby>` superscript layout. Can import Word documents that already contain annotations.
  - **Subtitles (`.srt`)**: Preserves timestamps and segmentation, and exports annotated subtitles.
  - **Plain text…

ChurchTao/Daoyou.description: 《万界道友》is an open-source game driven by AIGC, with a highly free text-based experience and a xianxia (immortal cultivation) worldview at its core. Here, you take on the body of an ordinary cultivator and, through techniques, spiritual roots, divine powers, magic treasures, and chance encounters, step by step chart your own path of cultivation.
ChurchTao/Daoyou.body:
# 万界道友

> The default entry point of this repository has moved to `NestJS + React SPA`. For the migration progress, see [migration notes](https://github.com/ChurchTao/Daoyou/blob/HEAD/docs/nestjs-migration.md). The instructions here reflect the current code and no longer apply to the legacy Next.js architecture.

---

## Project Vision

**《万界道友》** aims to build an "open-source skeleton for the cultivation universe." It is not only a text cultivation game that can be played right away, but also a highly structured, AIGC-friendly underlying architecture. Through **high-freedom input + AIGC feedback**, combined with **rigorous numerical and combat models**, we hope creators can quickly build their own cultivation worlds on top of it.

- **Gameplay**: Encourages players to shape characters through text descriptions, with AI generating real-time feedback, delivering a "thousand players, thousand faces" experience.
- **Systems**: Keeps the system stable, orthogonal, and composable, ensuring numerical balance and logical consistency.
- **Presentation**: Holds to "text as interface," using an ink-wash-style UI adapted for mobile.

## Core Features

- 🤖 **Deep AIGC integration**: Character backstories, battle reports, encounter stories, and item descriptions are all generated by AI across the full flow, so every playthrough is unique. Currently uses DeepSeek exclusively.
- ⚔️ **Deep combat engine**: Timeline-based turn-by-turn combat supporting divine powers, magic treasures, status effects (Buffs/Debuffs), Five Elements counter-relationships, damage pipelines, and other complex mechanics.
- ☯️ **Rigorous cultivation system**: Complete realms (from Qi Refining to Tribulation Crossing), spiritual roots (metal, wood, water, fire, earth, wind, thunder, ice), techniques, destiny, and alchemy and forging systems.
- 📱 **Ink-wash UI**: A pure text UI built with the `Ink` component library (21 components), clean, elegant, and immersive.
- 🛠️ **Developer-friendly**: Clear layered architecture (Engine/Service/API), full-stack TypeScript, easy to extend and remix.

## 🌌 万界

"万界" lists 《万界道友》servers deployed from this open-source repository and operated by different maintainers. Each realm may have different gameplay, settings, and community ecosystems. Feel free to choose the worlds that interest you and explore.

| Realm | Features | Website | Source code | Maintainer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 万界道友 | Officially maintained, offering the original gameplay and the latest features | [Enter this realm](https://client.daoyou.org) | [ChurchTao/Daoyou](https://github.com/ChurchTao/Daoyou) | [ChurchTao](https://github.com/ChurchTao) |
| 云梦界 | Expands on gameplay such as back-alley black markets, auction houses, and spirit fields, with a focus on player interaction, economic systems, and long-term progression; also has a WeChat mini-game client that shares the same server as the website | [Enter this realm](https://yzdoc.cn/game) |…

EricFL1998/HyperModes.description: A native-style mode and automation tool built for HyperOS
EricFL1998/HyperModes.body:
A native-style mode and automation tool built for HyperOS.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System requirements**: Android 17 (API 37) or later, and **Xiaomi HyperOS 4**.
> This version only supports OS4. OS3 (Android 16 and below) devices cannot install it, and the module will not load on older systems.

## Core Features

### 1. Deep system integration, extremely stable
The core logic of HyperModes runs in the `system_server` process. The app itself is only a configuration editor, which means:
- **Native experience**: Mode switching responds quickly, with no third-party background service resident.
- **Process independent**: Even if the HyperModes app is cleaned up or uninstalled, configured automation logic still runs accurately in the system.
- **Ultra-low power consumption**: Triggered by native system mechanisms, so it generates no extra standby power draw.

### 2. Deep integration with the official Clock app
Sleep mode connects directly to the bedtime feature of the official HyperOS Clock app:
- **Data sync**: Fully inherits the bedtime settings from the official Clock app.
- **High stability**: Uses the system's built-in bedtime trigger mechanism to solve the problem of third-party apps timing inaccurately or being killed.
- **Seamless handoff**: Supports triggering from the official alarm ringing, and feedback when it is dismissed manually.

### 3. Native interaction and advanced features
- **Native UI**: Fully follows the HyperOS / Miuix design language, providing an immersive experience.
- **Notification filtering**: Customize the do-not-disturb level for each mode, precisely controlling which important notifications get through.
- **App pausing**: After entering a specific mode, selected apps can be automatically paused (greyed out) to help you stay focused.
- **Custom status bar icons**:
    - **Semantic mapping**: Each mode has a unique monochrome vector icon that fits the system status bar.
    - **System integration**: A “Modes” toggle has been added to the system settings under “Icon display customization”, supporting native hide/show control.

## Installation and Usage

1. Install the APK.
2. Activate the module in LSPosed.
3. Restart the system for the hook to take effect.
4. Open Settings and start creating your personalized modes.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# Daily Agent Benchmarks

**Live site: https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/** · [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html) · [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml)

A daily, searchable list of new **AI / LLM agent benchmarks** on arXiv — web agents, GUI & computer-use agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, multi-agent, embodied, and agent safety evaluations. Each paper gets a page with authors, abstract, field, citation count, and arXiv PDF / HTML links. Updated automatically every day via GitHub Actions.

Collects **Agent Benchmark** papers from [arXiv](https://arxiv.org) daily and organizes them into a static site that can be deployed to GitHub Pages.

The site lists entries in reverse order of submission date: name, authors, abstract, category, and PDF / HTML links. Each day has a bilingual Chinese–English digest; ranked search runs in the browser using **BM25**.

## What this repository does

1. **Runs once a day** (via GitHub Actions; can also be run manually locally) and calls the arXiv API.
2. **Keeps only Agent Benchmark papers:** first retrieves candidates with agent + benchmark–related queries, then filters them with keyword scoring (LLM agent, web/GUI/coding agent, tool-use, computer-use, etc.). Excludes ordinary RL agents, reagents / pathogens, and other unrelated uses.
3. **Merges into the index** `docs/data/index.json`, grouped by `published` date.
4. **Generates the daily digest** (no paid model required): topic statistics plus the first sentence of the abstract for high-scoring papers, one each in Chinese and English.
5. **GitHub Pages** reads this JSON to render the pages. Search runs in the browser and does not depend on a backend.

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors the smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Immigration Department registration offices in Hong Kong, checking roughly every 2 minutes, and alerts subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official service of the Immigration Department. It only monitors and sends alerts, and does not automatically grab or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard Entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Access to github.io from mainland China is intermittent. jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so do not use them as web entry points.)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is through **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification path runs entirely through direct domestic connections and pushes slot releases to your phone immediately. The dashboard is only a helper.

## How It Works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ Fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request per run)
                            │  ├─ Diff against the previous snapshot → slot-release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by slot-release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements Over Similar Tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically in rows, so all 6 offices fit on one screen without horizontal table scrolling
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Anti-notification flooding:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (observed 304↔346 cell fluctuations within the same minute). The notification layer has a per-cell cooldown period, so it doesn't alert on every cycle
- **Direct access in mainland China:** the email subscription and Feishu notification paths are reachable directly within China, with no proxy needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer “what's the earliest date I can book”

hx101700/memoflow.body:
# MemoFlow

Chinese | [English](https://github.com/hx101700/memoflow/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

> MemoFlow is an interactive speech transcription and self-learning minutes generation skill for Codex.

> **Platform note: the current version only supports Windows 10/11 x64.**

MemoFlow is an interactive speech transcription and self-learning minutes generation skill for scenarios such as meeting transcription, content production, and call analysis. Users provide pre-recorded audio, enable features as needed, and confirm settings. Codex then calls Alibaba Cloud Bailian's ASR model to generate proofreading drafts in three formats: Word, Excel, and Markdown. In the future, MemoFlow will use an LLM to keep learning from users' proofread drafts, feedback, and existing formatted minutes documents, generating new minutes that match the user's habits, are neatly formatted, and are ready to deliver.

## Detailed Introduction

Many recording tools only produce a block of unprocessed text. Users then have to listen repeatedly, correct names and technical terms, distinguish speakers, and copy the content into their own document templates. The longer the recording, the more participants, and the stricter the format requirements, the more time-consuming this process becomes, and the easier it is to lose context.

MemoFlow first focuses on "hearing clearly, recognizing accurately, and delivering proofreading drafts," then gradually learns the user's priorities, expression style, and document formats. Users confirm settings in an interactive web page; Codex handles environment setup, authentication, invocation, and file delivery; Alibaba Cloud Bailian handles speech recognition. This removes the need to assemble commands manually or repeatedly paste full transcripts into the conversation, saving context and improving efficiency.

Codex excels at understanding context, organizing multi-step tasks, and continuing to process files, but speech recognition is not its core strength. In common speech workflows, Codex can call general-purpose multilingual recognition models such as [Whisper](https://github.com/openai/whisper); Whisper's performance varies across languages. Chinese dialects, names, product terminology, speaker diarization, and contextual understanding may still require substantial manual proofreading.

MemoFlow selects Alibaba Cloud Bailian's [Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR-Flash-Filetrans](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-audio-3-1-asr-flash-filetrans) as its speech recognition engine. According to Alibaba Cloud's official model documentation, it targets scenarios such as meeting transcription, content production, and call analysis. It supports multiple languages and regional Chinese dialects, and provides high-accuracy transcription, hotword and context enhancement, speaker diarization, punctuation prediction, and text normalization, making it well suited to non-real-time transcription of long audio. Qwen handles speech recognition, while Codex ties together web interaction, authentication, task execution, and result delivery. Together they address unclear speech, inaccurate terminology recognition, difficulty organizing multi-speaker content, and results that are hard to process further.

Subsequent personalized minutes generation will also rely on Codex…

## Voice input

When chatting, writing emails, or taking notes, press the shortcut once to start speaking and press it again to stop. MemoEcho removes filler words, tidies up sentence breaks, and then inserts the text into the current input field.

If you need to express yourself in another language, you can turn on translation. Common names and terms can be added to the dictionary, and MemoEcho also learns word choices from your edits to the output.

ljxpython/ai-agent-platform.body:
---

## Project Positioning: What Problem Does It Solve?

Many teams building Agents get stuck at the demo stage. Platform governance, runtime execution, state storage, and frontend interaction are all tangled into one "big ball of mud." When they move to production, they face missing permissions, lost state, difficult model switching, and slow, painful customization.

This project was built to solve that pain point. It provides an engineering foundation **that can be used directly for secondary development and for quickly building a private enterprise AI Agent platform**:

- **Decouple platform governance from Agent execution**: The platform layer is responsible for authentication and authorization, multi-tenant/project isolation, audit tracing, and model Catalog governance. The Agent runtime is responsible for graph orchestration, tool assembly, and state machine execution. The two layers communicate through managed contracts and do not contaminate each other.
- **Embrace mainstream open-source ecosystems instead of building closed wheels**: It is designed around the `LangGraph / LangChain` family of ecosystems and draws deeply on the engineering ideas of `open-swe`, `deepagents`, and `deer-flow`. It natively supports complex graph orchestration, state persistence, multi-turn tool-calling loops, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval interrupts.
- **Standardized customization skeleton**: It reserves clear extension points (custom Agent graphs, custom Tools, standard MCP services, Skills), so other enterprises can clone it directly as a template and quickly assemble their own business Agents.

## System Overview

The whole system is built as three layers of major services, each with its own role:

| Service | Directory | Responsibility | Core tech stack |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Platform API** | `apps/platform-api` | **Core of the control plane**: authentication and authorization, project governance, audit logs, model Catalog directory, managed contract gateway forwarding | FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL |
| **Platform Web** | `apps/platform-web` | **Admin console frontend**: workbench layout, Agent interactive chat flow, permission management, multi-end streaming rendering | Vue 3 + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Pinia |
| **Runtime Service** | `apps/runtime-service` | **Agent execution engine**: LangGraph graph registration, tool and MCP assembly, session scheduling, SSE event stream keep-alive push | Python 3.11+ + LangGraph + GraphHarbor + Redis |

LuoYuan (泺源) Microarchitecture Modeling and Simulation Platform is a software platform for modeling, exploring, and debugging processor microarchitectures. It is built on Visualized μarch Language (VUL), a new high-level chip description language.

Based on VUL, the LuoYuan platform provides designers of new microarchitectures with:

## What Is This

**Venera** is an excellent open-source comic reader that uses JavaScript-written comic source plugins to aggregate reading of local and online comics.

This branch (`compose-migration`) focuses on four core innovations:

1. **Pure native rewrite**: fully switched to Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, removing the Flutter/Dart/Rust runtimes for lower memory usage and millisecond-level cold starts.
2. **Miuix design language**: rebuilds the full screen with Xiaomi HyperOS's Miuix system and liquid glass material, with seamless switching between Material 3 dynamic color and the dual styles.
3. **Compatible plugin protocol**: fully compatible with the official ComicSource JavaScript plugin protocol, bundling 34 commonly used source scripts, with one-click import and update-all.
4. **Gallery and Pixiv multi-source aggregation**: a native 'Gallery' module on the bottom bar with full support for the Booru family of image sites and dual-domain Pixiv aggregation, including native work pages, artist pages, an account system, and smart cross-site direct jumps.

wlrwx/football-engine.description: Sporttery Football Probability Analysis System - Dixon-Coles + Monte Carlo integrated model, fully automated on GitHub Actions
wlrwx/football-engine.body:
# Sporttery Engine

Probability analysis and virtual betting simulation system for Sporttery football. Based on the Dixon-Coles Poisson model and Monte Carlo simulation, with market probabilities dominating the fusion, Kelly criterion for virtual bet allocation, and fully automated operation on GitHub Actions at zero server cost. **For data analysis and algorithm learning only. Does not constitute any betting advice. All outputs are virtual bookkeeping.**

## Core Principles (driven by 2026-08 data evidence)

1. **The market is the benchmark**: On 426 settled ledger matches, the pure market (vig-removed) Brier score of 0.583 outperforms every model stream (0.646+). Therefore the fusion weight is market-dominant (0.75), and models and third-party sources only make minor adjustments.
2. **Every switch is decided by data**: Each step of the fusion chain is a config switch (`config/prediction.json["fusion"]["post_fusion"]`). Whether each one stays is decided by `scripts/ablation_replay.py`, which runs paired replays on settled ledgers.
3. **Self-evolution with guardrails**: Any automatic enabling of the calibration layer or LGBM must pass a time-based split and a paired significance test. Components are automatically disabled on degradation. See `docs/UPGRADE2_20260829.md`.

## Architecture

```
Daily loop: fetch data → fusion prediction (fusion.py, fully traced) → lock → settle → self-learning
Weekly loop: backtest → weight optimization (champion/challenger) → parameter refit → Monday health check
Evolution loop: clean samples (chain=v2) accumulate → calibration layer auto re-enable/disable (calibration_auto)
                      → LGBM shadow training + validation (lgbm_shadow) → weekly effect evaluation (tracker)
```

## Tech Stack

- Python 3.12 / numpy / scikit-learn / LightGBM / joblib
- GitHub Actions (computation) + GitHub Pages (reports)
- No database. Plain CSV/JSON with git versioning. Ledgers are append-only.

## Directory Structure

```
engine/
├── prediction/     # dixon_coles / monte_carlo / fusion (pure functions + switches + trace) / lgbm
├── strategy/       # kelly / odds-level (水位) signal gate / hot-zone stake sizing / edge cap / three-ticket system
├── learning/       # fusion_optimizer (weight self-tuning) / calibration_auto (calibration self-evolution)
│                   # lgbm_shadow (shadow training) / league_params / elo
├──…

---

FileCat is a self-hosted Web file server and a **lightweight server management tool**. Once deployed, you can manage files on your server anytime and anywhere through a browser, while also enjoying a wide range of server management and operations features.

FileCat is a lightweight, self-deployed web file and tools server. Its UI supports access from mobile devices. Built on a file server, this project provides many features for developers (intranet tunneling, CI/CD, viewing large log files, viewing system information, a secure SSH terminal, etc.). File access supports previews and editing in many formats, and supports WYSIWYG editing for markdown (.md).

FileCat uses the UI of [filebrowser](https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser).

> **Core philosophy**: Centered around file management, FileCat integrates AI Agent, remote desktop, intranet tunneling, system monitoring, and other capabilities to make server management simpler.
